correctness.rationale: Rebuilt coefficient formula T_g e_n=sum_m b_m log m/log(nm)e_{nm} and factorization T_g=D M_h. Finite prime-torus polynomial multiplier has exact H2 norm C_g; deleting N-1 input coordinates gives s_N<=C_g/log(2N). A finite norm-approximating polynomial over the finitely many prime coordinates, shifted by integers r coprime to their product, generates a positive-density orthogonal family of images with norm >=(C_g-epsilon)/log(c N), establishing min-max lower bound for all N, not just a subsequence. Formula handles n=1, constants, arbitrary dependent frequencies and complex coefficients. Powers shift indices by >=2 so ||T_g^k||<=(C_g/log2)^k/k!. Explicit monomial weights are orthogonal. Original independent tests checked monomial coefficient sequences and coprime fibers; finite checks are not asymptotic proofs.
